description: Run full asset build, Elixir precommit and browser suite across all configured browsers; fix failures before committing and pushing current authentication branch changes.

comments.text: Full validation underway before any commit/push. Fresh mix assets.build and mix precommit passed (179 tests, strict Credo/format/warnings checks). Three-node Mnesia integration check passed. Added automatic renewal cases both passed in Chromium. Full Playwright suite has 330 tests across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit and is running; logs /tmp/ww-full-e2e.log. User explicitly requires all tests pass before push.

User stopped Firefox/WebKit. Final full-run report: 218 passed, 2 failed (same watchdog test in Chromium and Firefox), 110 WebKit tests not run. Earlier progress updates incorrectly inferred no failures from tail snippets; corrected user explicitly. Root cause: watchdog test drops widget.submit frame; Phoenix PUSH_TIMEOUT=30000 invokes reloadWithJitter and disconnects before app 300000 timeout. New connection UI correctly disables send. Test now installs clock before load and extends only its held-submit transport deadline to isolate five-minute application watchdog, preserving prior assertions plus connected-state assertion. Targeted Chromium test passed. Running full Chromium only before commit/push.

title: Validate full test suites and publish reconnect changes
